speaker: Doctor
text:
I am Dr. Agent. You are here because of sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; to begin our assessment, on a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is this pain?

Additionally, does the pain travel past your knee, and have you noticed any weakness, numbness, or tingling in that leg?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation (likely L5-S1).

Based on your description of sudden onset pain during exercise radiating to the foot, I suspect a herniated disc. Do you have any numbness in the big toe or weakness in lifting your foot (foot drop)?
